clauses.title: LEASED EQUIPMENT AND TERM DURATION
clauses.verbatim_text: Lessor leases to Lessee two (2) CAT 336 Hydraulic Excavators for a fixed operational term of twenty-four (24) months commencing on December 1, 2026.
obligations: Lessor must lease two (2) CAT 336 Hydraulic Excavators to Lessee for 24 months commencing December 1, 2026
rights: Lessee receives possession and operational use of two CAT 336 Hydraulic Excavators
material_claims: Lease of two (2) CAT 336 Hydraulic Excavators
Fixed operational term of twenty-four (24) months starting December 1, 2026

clauses.title: MONTHLY RENTAL AND SECURITY DEPOSIT
clauses.verbatim_text: Lessee shall pay monthly rent of fourteen thousand five hundred dollars ($14,500) per unit, due on the first day of each month. Lessee shall remit a thirty thousand dollar ($30,000) security deposit.
obligations: Lessee must pay monthly rent of $14,500 per unit on the first day of each month
rights: Lessor receives $14,500/month per excavator and $30,000 security deposit
conditions: Rent payable on the first day of each calendar month
material_claims: Monthly rent of $14,500 per unit due on the first day of each month

clauses.title: EQUIPMENT MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS
clauses.verbatim_text: Lessee assumes full responsibility for all preventive maintenance, lubrication, track repairs, and daily inspections in accordance with manufacturer operating specifications.
obligations: Lessee must perform all preventive maintenance, lubrication, track repairs, and daily inspections per manufacturer specifications
rights: Lessor is relieved of routine maintenance and repair costs
conditions: Must comply with manufacturer operating specifications
material_claims: Lessee bears full responsibility for preventive maintenance, lubrication, track repairs, and daily inspections
Must adhere to manufacturer operating specifications

clauses.title: INSURANCE AND CASUALTY INDEMNITY
clauses.verbatim_text: Lessee must maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000) and indemnify Lessor against any workplace property loss or bodily injury claims.
obligations: Lessee must maintain >= $2,000,000 commercial general liability insurance
Lessee must indemnify Lessor against workplace property loss and bodily injury claims
rights: Lessor is indemnified and protected by $2,000,000 CGL insurance policy
material_claims: Mandatory commercial general liability insurance of at least $2,000,000
Lessee must indemnify Lessor against property loss and bodily injury claims

clauses.title: TOTAL CASUALTY LOSS AND REPLACEMENT VALUE
clauses.verbatim_text: In the event of total destruction or theft of any unit, Lessee shall pay Lessor the agreed replacement valuation of three hundred eighty thousand dollars ($380,000) per excavator within thirty (30) days.
obligations: Lessee must pay agreed replacement valuation of $380,000 per excavator within 30 days of total destruction or theft
rights: Lessor is guaranteed $380,000 replacement value per unit on total loss
conditions: Triggered in the event of total destruction or theft of any unit
material_claims: Agreed replacement valuation is $380,000 per excavator
Triggered upon total destruction or theft
Payment must be made within thirty (30) days

clauses.title: GOVERNING LAW AND COURT VENUE
clauses.verbatim_text: This Lease shall be governed by the laws of the State of Ohio. All legal proceedings shall be litigated exclusively in the state courts situated in Franklin County, Ohio.
obligations: Litigate legal proceedings exclusively in state courts of Franklin County, Ohio
material_claims: Governed by the laws of the State of Ohio
Exclusive venue in Franklin County, Ohio state courts
